title: Build
gkm: To build a house; to build up.
refs: Except the LORD build the house, they labour in vain that build it
Through wisdom is an house builded; and by understanding it is established
Let us rise up and build
Intending to build a tower, sitteth not down first, and counteth the cost
note: Ken, 19 Nov: K-Tech's fish is Matthew 7:24, so that verse leaves the back and Nehemiah 2:18 takes its place (the same swap the website makes). The Greek here is still Jude's word (G2026); Matthew 7:24 uses oikodomeo (G3618). Ken, 19 Nov: the Greek is now oikodomeo (G3618), the word in Matthew 7:24, in place of Jude's epoikodomeo (G2026).
